changelog: Fixes the rebuilt configuration page, which arrived unstyled: Jellyfin keeps only the body of a plugin page, so the stylesheet in the head never reached the browser and the whole layout fell back to one plain column. The stylesheet now lives in the body, where the other plugins that ship one keep theirs. The page also measures the room it has left rather than guessing at it, so it fits the window whatever the dashboard puts above it.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
